ACTION_KEEPER.NotInCombat: This token is not participating in the current combat.
ACTION_KEEPER.AutoOpenHint: Automatically open the Action Keeper panel when combat begins.
ACTION_KEEPER.AutoCloseHint: Automatically close the Action Keeper panel when combat ends.
ACTION_KEEPER.LabeledButtonsHint: Show the icon and Available/Used text on each slot. When off, slots render as compact filled/hollow circles.
ACTION_KEEPER.LanguageHint: Panel language for all players (English, Português, Español, Deutsch, Русский).
